about.text: a buffalo milk cheese of the Fujian province in China; it is prepared in a ball shape approximately the size of a table tennis ball, and has a soft, leathery texture.

sources.text: Corrected: milk set with vinegar (acid), shaped in cloth and marinated in salty brine; table-tennis-ball-sized, soft and leathery, very salty condiment for congee; Zhangzhou, Fujian
